content: Each person comes into this world with a specific destiny — he has something to fulfill, some message has to be delivered, some work has to be completed.
author: Osho
sourceWork: The Book of Secrets (Vigyana Bhairava Tantra)
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. From childhood, we are trained to fit in, to smooth over our eccentricities, and to mirror the expectations of those around us. But copying others only buys superficial acceptance at the cost of your own soul.

In Osho's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. Your unique perspective and lived contradictions are your greatest offering to the world. The moment you stop performing and stand firmly in your own skin, you command an authority that imitation can never manufacture.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your current routine are you choosing convenient illusion over uncomfortable truth?
